metadata.description: Minimal epoch-1 response read by the synchronous OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions provider seam. The contract identifies the answer, recovers ordered assistant text, and optionally records provider-independent token usage for cost accounting.
Assistant choices in provider order. The provider layer rejects an empty choice list before producing a domain result.
Provider-independent token counts when the endpoint reports them. Additional provider-specific usage details remain outside this projection.
A Chat Completions choice is an assistant message in the text-only epoch-1 seam.
